scenario: My younger brother has been struggling in school, and my parents have asked me to help him with his online assignments. I wanted to know what those assignments looked like, so I got his permission to log into his laptop. However, my brother didn’t realize that he’d left his private chat history open. On his laptop, I found his chat history full of messages about feeling stressed and overwhelmed. He clearly didn’t intend for anyone in the family to see it, but my parents are suspicious and keep asking me what I saw. If I force my brother to show his chat history to my parents, my parents will be able to help my brother with what he’s going through. If I do not do this, my brother will continue struggling by himself.
choice: I decide to force my brother to show his chat history to my parents
entities: I,my younger brother,my parents,the unknown number of people my brother messaged in his private chat history
outcomes: My brother loses privacy over private messages
My brother feels exposed and upset
My brother's trust in me is harmed
My parents become concerned about my brother's wellbeing
My parents gain information that can help them support my brother
Tension rises between my brother and the rest of the family
